Class ServerSocketCloseTest<A extends SocketAddress>

java.lang.Object
org.newsclub.net.unix.SocketTestBase<A>
org.newsclub.net.unix.ServerSocketCloseTest<A>
Direct Known Subclasses:
ServerSocketCloseTest, ServerSocketCloseTest, ServerSocketCloseTest
public abstract class ServerSocketCloseTest<A extends SocketAddress> extends SocketTestBase<A>
Ensures that we don't have any dangling "accept" calls after closing our ServerSocket.
